mechanism: Chlorthalidone may reduce renal clearance of amoxicillin and increase its serum levels, while amoxicillin may compete for renal tubular secretion; additionally, thiazide-like diuretics can cause hypokalemia which may potentiate certain adverse effects.
action: Monitor renal function and amoxicillin efficacy; ensure adequate hydration and consider electrolyte monitoring, particularly potassium levels; adjust amoxicillin dosing if renal impairment is present.
